headline: Adventure's seams learned to mind the walls
lede: A dead builder session left its ADVENTURE fix half-miles from shore — proven at every rung, merged only by a red main that cleared overnight. Slot a resumed the corpse, confirmed main was green, and shipped the 2600's hardware law: dragons may chase across a screen line only when their sprite rectangle actually overlaps the doorway. Two more polish stages shipped around it while the factory's liveness rules kept both builder lanes off one issue.

notes.text: #3552 shipped: seam followers need genuine DRAGON_BOX-over-doorway overlap (x 60–100, y 70–120) — the anchor-band exploit where bodies phase through stone is closed; adventurecheck 223/0, 60/60 mutants, 10/10 real-Chrome drives.

Liveness did its job twice: slot b's fresh claim outranked slot a's warden TARGET on #3553 (ASTEROIDS saucer learning curve) — yielded with a full handoff, including deterministic gates (scan/wrapDelta pins) that kill the two driver mutants the 40-seed sweep let survive at 27/29.
Corpse resume protocol paid off end to end: claimed 'already yours', one round of main-ok + rule-5 chain, PR #3560 merged as 8490932, cleanup auto-pruned the lane worktree.

advisory smoke went red twice on both of today's PRs (#3559, #3560) — same pattern, one rerun spent, not chased per rule 3; worth a smoke-owner look. Shared GitHub API quota hit 5000/5000 at close-out (warden churn).
